scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide-angle view of a city street corner with a mix of pedestrians, cyclists, and parked motorcycles along the sidewalk, surrounded by tall buildings and trees. The street is paved with gray concrete and has a slight curve to the right, with white lines marking pedestrian crossings and bike lanes. A woman rides a bicycle down the sidewalk, while others walk or stand around, some near the curb and others further up the street. Trees line the sidewalk, casting dappled shadows on the ground. In the distance, a large building stands out with its ornate facade and multiple stories.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building has a mix of old and new architecture, with a curved corner and a flat roof. It has several windows and balconies, and a few decorative elements such as columns and arches. The building appears to be well-maintained but shows signs of wear and tear, with some cracks and peeling paint.
